_readme: What each payment out of the marketing wallet was for.
The chain can tell you the amount, the token, the recipient and the
block. It cannot tell you WHY, and no page that invents a reason from
chain data is telling the truth. So the reasons live here, in a file in
the repository, which means relabelling a payment is a commit with an
author and a date on it rather than a quiet edit to a database.
Key is the transaction hash, lowercase. Anything paid out and not listed
here shows on the page as UNLABELLED, in red. That is deliberate: a
transparency page that can hide a payment by omission is a press release.
